what: It supplies staff to airport cargo, ground handling and passenger service companies in Hong Kong.

risks: The holding company relies on its Hong Kong subsidiary for cash, and any limit on payments from it could harm the business.
Chinese rules and any future changes could hurt the Hong Kong business and sharply cut the value of the shares.
